extraction.Name: Susan Utterback
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded by the Belvidere State Bank on July 10, 1918
extraction.Buyer: Susan Estes, formerly Susan Utterback and Edward F. Estes conveyed the land by deed to J. E. Utterback for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612456 issued; Lots 5 and 6 of section 6, Lots 2, 3 and 4, and Southeast quarter of Northwest quarter, section 7, township 44, north of range 32; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee but not dated; conveyance dated March 20, 1918; allottee also known as Susan Estes
